node.title: Re: XML access the REPEATING NODE VALUES
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext: When an XSLT query, as supported by XML::LibXML would accomplish this task with no Perl custom-programming at all, the use of Simple is, simply, unjustifiable. The LibXML package uses an industry-standard binary library to do any sort of XML manipulation that you may require. (And, if the XML file is so enormous that you simply can't parse it into memory, use XML::Twig.) Don't use anything else today.
